note: Per-photo crop focus for the scraped gallery pool. content/generated/gallery.json is regenerated from scratch on every sync, so a `focus` value hand-edited there is silently destroyed on the next run -- this file is where it has to live instead. sources/gallery/index.mjs applies it at generation time.
howItWorks: The value is a CSS object-position. The display crops each photo to 16:9, and the percentage says which part of the photo's height survives: 0% keeps the top, 100% keeps the bottom, and the default is 'center 35%'. A tall group portrait usually needs a LOWER number, because faces are near the top and 35% starts the crop below them.

a6d929e4f68006b2d1feb20db6b3c919.reason: Three people holding a quilt, 1080x1204. At the default 35% the crop begins below their chins and shows torsos only; 15% keeps all three faces with clean headroom.
